name: week
title: Weekly data centre review
subtitle: Declared records only. Check site conditions before work.

sections.title: Cabinet capacity
sections.sql: select site,cabinet,units,occupied_units,budget_w,allocated_w,incomplete_assets from v_capacity order by site,cabinet

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select site,name,issue from v_attention order by site,name

sections.title: Open changes
sections.sql: select reference,asset,kind,due,status from v_change_review where status in ('draft','approved') order by due

sections.title: Inventory
sections.sql: select site,name,cabinet,unit_start,height,power_w,status,owner from v_inventory order by site,cabinet,unit_start

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.note: OPS checks are internal policy. NZ-ELEC checks flag missing references, not legal certification.
sections.sql: select site,name,issue,rule from v_compliance order by rule,site,name
